items.question: How do I book a private chauffeur or excursion with Riviora?
items.answer: Booking takes 3 steps: fill in our online form, call us at +33 7 87 24 86 91, or email contact@riviora.fr. We reply within 2 hours with a confirmation and final quote. For urgent bookings, call us directly — we are available 24/7.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept bank transfers, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), and cash. For businesses, we offer deferred invoicing. No deposit is required for standard transfers; a 30% deposit is requested for full-day excursions or longer.

items.question: Are there extra charges for flight delays?
items.answer: No. We track all flights in real time using the flight number you provide. If your flight is delayed, your driver adjusts their arrival time at no extra charge. Airport waiting is included for up to 60 minutes after landing.

items.question: Can I customise my excursion itinerary?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every Riviora excursion is fully customisable. Tell us your interests (gastronomy, culture, beaches, shopping, photography…), your schedule constraints and activity level. Your driver-guide will adapt the programme in real time to your wishes.

items.question: How many passengers can your vehicles accommodate?
items.answer: Our Mercedes V-Class comfortably seats up to 8 passengers with their luggage. For groups of 9 to 21 people, we have a fitted Mercedes Sprinter. For larger groups, we can coordinate multiple vehicles — contact us for a group quote.

items.question: Do your drivers speak English?
items.answer: Yes. All our drivers are bilingual French-English, and some also speak Italian, Spanish or Arabic. For groups requiring a specific language, please specify this when booking.

items.question: Do you offer excursions from Cannes, Monaco or other cities?
items.answer: Yes, Riviora operates from all major cities on the Côte d'Azur: Nice, Cannes, Monaco, Antibes, Menton, Saint-Raphaël. Simply tell us your departure point when booking and we will adjust the fare accordingly.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Free cancellation up to 48h before the service. Between 24h and 48h: 50% of the amount retained. Less than 24h: 100% retained. No-shows are charged in full. For force majeure (extreme weather, illness with documentation), we always find a solution.

items.question: Is Riviora available in the evenings, at weekends and on public holidays?
items.answer: Yes, we are available 24/7, 365 days a year, including public holidays and during major events (Monaco Grand Prix, Cannes Film Festival, etc.). A night surcharge (+20%) applies from 10pm to 6am.

items.question: Can I hire a vehicle with a chauffeur for a full day?
items.answer: Yes, it is one of our most popular packages. Full-day chauffeur hire (8h) lets you visit multiple destinations at your own pace, with no time constraints. Perfect for exploring the Riviera in depth. From €480/day.
